# SCION SCXML conformance fixtures

The files in this directory are copied from the SCION SCXML test framework:

- Source: https://github.com/jbeard4/scxml-test-framework (`test/` directory, commit `b46a10a1c3a3b1ca5c5cb4bb44ddb5c785611f41`)
- Copyright 2011-2012 Jacob Beard, INFICON, and other SCION contributors
- License: Apache License 2.0, in [`LICENSE.txt`](LICENSE.txt)

These files are not covered by the MIT license of the rest of this repository.

## Changes

- Only some of the upstream tests are included. The `.scxml` charts are unchanged.
- The `.json` test scripts were reformatted: whitespace and indentation only. Their content is unchanged.

## W3C tests

The files in [`w3c-ecma`](w3c-ecma) are SCION's versions of tests from the W3C SCXML 1.0 Implementation Report test suite (https://www.w3.org/Voice/2013/scxml-irp/). W3C licenses that suite under both the W3C Test Suite License and the W3C 3-clause BSD License. These files are used under the W3C 3-clause BSD License:
